    protected static function validateIndexLookup(array $lookup_array, $index_number): int

        // VLOOKUP(whatever, whatever, cellref) yields REF error

            throw new Exception(ExcelError::REF());

        bool $bothNotNumeric,

    ): ?int {

        }

    }
